issues.description: The problem statement and tests expect public getters for all attributes (e.g., getLectureName(), getNumberOfInscribedStudents()), but the solution implementation declares getLectureName() and getNumberOfInscribedStudents() as private. This visibility mismatch would prevent students (and automated tests) from accessing these getters and will cause failing tests or confusion about required method visibility.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the visibility of the getters getLectureName() and getNumberOfInscribedStudents() to public in the implementation (and ensure the template instructions indicate public getters). This aligns the solution with the problem/tests requiring public accessors.
